title: Hedgehog holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Balloon string -->
  <path d='M 62 30 Q 65 45 60 58' stroke='#A8D8EA' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  
  <!-- Balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='22' rx='12' ry='14' fill='#FF5A5F'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='22' rx='12' ry='14' fill='none' stroke='#FF8A8D' stroke-width='1'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='18' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#FFB3B5' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- Balloon knot -->
  <polygon points='62,35 64,38 66,35' fill='#E04045'/>
  
  <!-- Hedgehog body -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='68' rx='22' ry='16' fill='#C4956A'/>
  
  <!-- Spines -->
  <g fill='#8B5E3C'>
    <polygon points='22,60 26,48 30,58'/>
    <polygon points='28,56 33,42 37,54'/>
    <polygon points='36,53 41,38 45,52'/>
    <polygon points='44,52 49,39 53,51'/>
    <polygon points='52,54 57,42 60,54'/>
    <polygon points='58,58 63,48 64,60'/>
  </g>
  <!-- Spine highlights -->
  <g fill='#A87A4E'>
    <polygon points='24,58 27,50 29,57'/>
    <polygon points='38,51 42,40 44,50'/>
    <polygon points='54,53 57,44 59,54'/>
  </g>
  
  <!-- Face -->
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='68' rx='12' ry='11' fill='#E8C9A0'/>
  
  <!-- Eye -->
  <circle cx='31' cy='65' r='2.5' fill='#3A2A1A'/>
  <circle cx='30.5' cy='64.5' r='0.8' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  
  <!-- Nose -->
  <circle cx='25' cy='70' r='2.5' fill='#4A3525'/>
  <circle cx='24.5' cy='69.5' r='0.6' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  
  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d='M 27 73 Q 30 76 33 73' stroke='#4A3525' stroke-width='1' fill='none'/>
  
  <!-- Cheek -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='73' r='2' fill='#F0A0A0' opacity='0.5'/>
  
  <!-- Ear -->
  <ellipse cx='41' cy='60' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#E8C9A0'/>
  <ellipse cx='41' cy='60' rx='1.5' ry='2.5' fill='#F0A0A0' opacity='0.4'/>
  
  <!-- Front legs -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='82' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#B8845A'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#B8845A'/>
  
  <!-- Arm holding balloon string -->
  <path d='M 52 70 Q 58 62 60 58' stroke='#B8845A' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- Little paw on string -->
  <circle cx='60' cy='58' r='3' fill='#C4956A'/>
  
  <!-- Belly -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='76' rx='12' ry='8' fill='#E8C9A0' opacity='0.6'/>
</svg>
